manifest.title: Cohort-Scale Infradian Rhythmicity in Continuous Heart Rate: Exploratory Spectral Discovery
manifest.cohort: German Corona Data Donation — Apple Watch Single-Source (N = 11,139)
manifest.target_estimand: Observational screening for 25–35 day infradian rhythmicity across sex and age strata
manifest.epistemic_classification: Exploratory Discovery: Unstratified cohort screening; hypothesis generation
manifest.validation_protocol: Lomb-Scargle Periodogram & Single-Harmonic Cosinor Regression; wear-time artifact contrast
manifest.key_findings: Observed distinct spectral peak at ~28.5 days in young reproductive-age females (18–35y), largely attenuated in older females and males. Physiology amplitude ~1.67 bpm markedly distinct from wear artifacts.

manifest.title: Standardized Exposure & Continuous AR(1) Bootstrap Validation of Infradian Heart-Rate Cycles
manifest.cohort: Qualified Apple Watch Cohort with >= 120-Day Standardized Continuous Window (N = 4,631)
manifest.target_estimand: Statistical excess spectral power in 25–35 day window calibrated against AR(1) surrogate noise
manifest.epistemic_classification: Calibrated Hypothesis Testing: Controlled exposure null testing against serially correlated noise
manifest.validation_protocol: Per-participant Continuous AR(1) bootstrap (B = 199), HC3 robust Wald tests, Holm multiplicity adjustment
manifest.key_findings: Young females display significant 25–35 day excess power over subject-specific red-noise nulls (Wald chi^2 = 14.82, p < 0.001). Wear-compliance metric showed zero significant excess power, confirming biological origin.

manifest.title: Longitudinal Period Stability, Acrophase Phase-Locking, and Metabolic Invariance of Infradian Rhythms
manifest.cohort: Long-History Cohort (N = 502 with >= 365 days) and WHO BMI Strata (Underweight, Normal, Overweight, Obese)
manifest.target_estimand: Sliding 90-day period drift, calendar acrophase Rayleigh uniformity, and BMI ANCOVA contrasts
manifest.epistemic_classification: Confirmatory Mechanisms: Longitudinal persistence, circular uniformity, and biological covariate invariance
manifest.validation_protocol: Sliding 90-day window tracking, Rayleigh test of circular uniformity, multivariable OLS ANCOVA with HC3 errors
manifest.key_findings: Period stability confirmed over >= 365 days (mean drift < 1.2 days). Acrophase distribution is circular uniform (Rayleigh p = 0.870), ruling out calendar/lunar artifact (wear showed p = 2.25e-11). Amplitude invariant to BMI (p = 0.609).

manifest.title: Downstream Predictive Utility of Infradian Rhythm Representations for Recorded Sex Classification
manifest.cohort: Apple Watch Allocation 0 Held-out Test Set (N_test = 1,671; N_train = 7,797)
manifest.target_estimand: Test AUROC gain from augmenting diurnal/circadian baselines with 11 infradian features
manifest.epistemic_classification: Predictive Utility: Translation of biological rhythmicity into machine learning performance on unseen data
manifest.validation_protocol: Strict Allocation 0 test evaluation; 2,000 paired stratified bootstrap replicates for CIs and p-values
manifest.key_findings: Infradian features yield statistically significant AUROC gains: +0.0109 on clock baseline (p < 0.001) and +0.0061 on linear baseline (p < 0.001). Subgroup AUROC in young females reaches 0.9071.

manifest.title: Missing-Data Imputation and Observation-Mask Architecture Sensitivity Across Apple Watch Allocations
manifest.cohort: Apple Watch Allocations 0, 1, 2 (N = 11,139 total across 10-fold allocations)
manifest.target_estimand: 8-arm fill and mask ablation: H_clock vs H_global, short-gap interpolation, clean diff, mask concat/stack
manifest.epistemic_classification: Architecture Sensitivity: Systematic sensitivity analysis of missing-data handling across recording patterns
manifest.validation_protocol: MultiRocket feature extraction + Ridge regression across 3 independent holdout allocations; Continuity x Occupancy x History subgroups
manifest.key_findings: User-specific clock median filling (H_clock) dominates global median across all allocations and subgroups. Short-gap interpolation provides marginal benefits in dense records; explicit mask concatenation improves low-occupancy stability.

manifest.title: Circular Diurnal Template Regularization: Reference Specification & Empirical Benchmark
manifest.cohort: 200 Stratified Test Participants (11,900 Masked Gaps) & Allocation 0 Test Cohort (N = 1,671)
manifest.target_estimand: 1D Circular Gaussian smoothing across midnight (sigma in {1,2,4}); Masked MAE, RMSE, Boundary Jump, and Downstream AUROC
manifest.epistemic_classification: Template Regularization: Mathematical derivation, unit verification, and empirical gap-filling optimization
manifest.validation_protocol: Masked imputation benchmark (59,500 evaluations); Allocation 0 Ridge regression benchmark; 1,000 paired bootstrap replicates
manifest.key_findings: Optimal regularizer is sigma* = 1 bin (5 min), minimizing RMSE (9.628 bpm) and boundary jump (8.637 bpm). Downstream AUROC improves in low-occupancy participants (+0.0028 template-only, +0.0018 combined), buffering against sparse diurnal noise.

manifest.title: Apple Watch to Garmin Cross-Cohort Transferability Pilot Benchmark
manifest.cohort: Garmin Pilot (N = 1,000) and Apple Watch Pilot (N = 1,000)
manifest.target_estimand: Cross-device domain transfer performance of diurnal and circadian representation features
manifest.epistemic_classification: Cross-Cohort Generalization: External validity assessment across heterogeneous sensor ecosystems
manifest.validation_protocol: Train-on-Apple, test-on-Garmin (and reciprocal); out-of-domain AUROC and domain adaptation diagnostics
manifest.key_findings: Diurnal median templates exhibit robust cross-device domain transfer (AUROC > 0.65 across devices), whereas high-frequency temporal autocorrelation features show sensor-specific recording calibration bias.

manifest.title: Full Single-Source Apple Watch Cohort Scaling Benchmark Report
manifest.cohort: Qualified Apple Watch Participants with >= 14 Adequate Days (N = 11,139 across 10 repeated holdouts)
manifest.target_estimand: MultiRocket sequence classification scaling, history budget allocation (40-day vs unconstrained), and 5-min vs 15-min resolution
manifest.epistemic_classification: Cohort Scaling: Large-sample benchmark scaling and computational feasibility reference
manifest.validation_protocol: 10 repeated OR-Tools balanced 70/15/15 holdouts (N_train = 7,797, N_val = 1,671, N_test = 1,671)
manifest.key_findings: 5-minute resolution consistently outperforms 15-minute resolution across all allocations. Unconstrained history achieves test AUROC 0.732 +/- 0.008. MultiRocket sequence kernels demonstrate stable asymptotic scaling.

manifest.title: Cross-Device Garmin Replication, Sample Scaling, and Spectral Diagnostics of Infradian Heart-Rate Cycles
manifest.cohort: Garmin Tier 1c Single-Source (N = 3,760 qualified) & Apple Watch Extended (N = 5,516 qualified)
manifest.target_estimand: Cross-device external validity of 25–35d excess infradian power, period persistence, and 3–120d spectral diagnostics
manifest.epistemic_classification: Cross-Cohort Generalization & Spectral Diagnostics: Independent device replication and long-period red-noise resolution
manifest.validation_protocol: Independent Garmin cohort evaluation; B=199 two-component null bootstrap; 3–120d harmonic sweeps; nonoverlapping second-window persistence
manifest.key_findings: Garmin cohort independently confirms young female infradian excess (contrast +0.0474, Wald chi^2 = 81.1, p < 1e-17). Spectral diagnostics (3–120d) resolve long-period male rise as red-noise continuum and polynomial drift rather than harmonic resonance.

manifest.title: Continuous-Age Dependence of Monthly Resting Heart-Rate Rhythmicity: Restricted Cubic Spline Sex-by-Age Analysis
manifest.cohort: Apple Watch (expanded90 N = 5,162) and Garmin Tier 1c (expanded90 N = 3,754); Samsung non-estimable (N = 8)
manifest.target_estimand: Female-minus-male contrast in band-integrated 25–35d excess power as a continuous function of age (Harrell RCS, knots 25/42/52/65)
manifest.epistemic_classification: Confirmatory Mechanism: Pre-specified RCS model with stratified bootstrap inference; cross-sectional, associational
manifest.validation_protocol: Stone-Koo RCS, chunk Wald tests (HC3), 2,000 stratified participant bootstraps, simultaneous bands, two-component REML nulls, second-window repeatability
manifest.key_findings: Steepest decline of the female-male contrast at 46.65y (Apple, CI 45.40-47.40) and 47.25y (Garmin, CI 44.45-48.50). Nominal zero-crossing 56.18y (Apple) and 70.20y (Garmin); simultaneous-band cessation not reached for Q_i. Second-window repeatability present in females <55y, absent in females >=55y and males.
